app.title: System Recovery
app.desc: Keeps a recovery environment on your disk. If Equestria OS stops booting, pick it in the boot menu — no USB stick needed.
wizard.title: System Recovery
wizard.desc: Finds your installed Equestria OS, looks for what broke and fixes it.
status.not_installed: The recovery environment is not installed.
status.not_installed_hint: Download it now: when the system no longer boots it will be too late.
status.no_entry: The image is downloaded, but the boot menu entry is missing.
status.no_entry_hint: Install the image again to add the entry.
status.low_ram: This computer has {0} of memory: the recovery environment will run from the disk, so disk checks will not be available there.
image.hint: The image is the regular Equestria OS live system, about 5.5 GB.
recover.how: If Equestria OS does not boot, choose “Equestria OS Recovery” in the menu that appears when the computer starts. The recovery wizard opens by itself.
recover.one_shot_unsupported: GRUB can write neither to /boot/grub nor to the EFI partition here — choose the entry in the boot menu yourself.
live.hint: You are in the live environment. The wizard will find the installed system and repair it.
progress.installing: Checking the image and adding it to the boot menu…
confirm.download: Download Equestria OS {0} ({1})? You can keep using the computer meanwhile; an interrupted download continues where it stopped.
confirm.remove: Remove the recovery environment? The boot menu entry will disappear too.
confirm.reboot: Restart now into the recovery environment? Save your work first. The next start after that will be normal.
done.installed: Done. The “Equestria OS Recovery” entry is in the boot menu.
start.title: Repair the installed system
start.text: The wizard looks for Equestria OS on the disks of this computer, checks what keeps it from booting — boot images, kernel, free space, unfinished updates, the boot loader — and fixes it. Your files are not touched.
start.text_recovery: You booted into the recovery environment. The wizard will find the installed Equestria OS, check what keeps it from booting — boot images, kernel, free space, unfinished updates, the boot loader — and fix it. Your files are not touched.
choose.title: Which system to repair?
choose.none: No installed system was found. You can reinstall Equestria OS or open a terminal.
choose.fsck: Check the disk for errors first
choose.fsck_hint: Takes from a few seconds to several minutes. Recommended after a power loss.
choose.fsck_busy: Not available: the recovery image is read from this partition. Pick “Equestria OS Recovery” (not “low memory”) in the boot menu to check the disk.
repair.title: Result
repair.none: No problems found. If the system still does not boot, try “Rebuild boot images” and “Repair boot loader” below.
repair.warnings_only: Nothing critical, but there are warnings.
tools.title: Tools
tools.reinstall_hint: Reinstalling erases the system partition you choose in the installer.
tools.reinstall_blocked: Reinstalling is not possible from here: the recovery image itself lives on the system disk. Boot from a USB stick to reinstall, or choose “Equestria OS Recovery” (copies itself to memory).
busy.diagnose: Looking for problems… (checking packages may take a minute)
confirm.clean_cache: Downloaded packages that are not installed will be deleted from the package cache to free space.
confirm.remove_fallback: Fallback boot images (initramfs-*-fallback.img) will be deleted from /boot to free space. The main images stay.
confirm.reinstall: Damaged packages will be downloaded again and the system updated to the latest versions.
confirm.finish_update: The system will be updated to the latest versions (pacman -Syu).
confirm.repair_grub: The GRUB boot loader will be reinstalled and its menu regenerated.
confirm.fs_repair: Errors were found on the disk. Fix them now? It is usually safe, but files damaged by the errors may end up in lost+found.
confirm.reinstall_system: Start the Equestria OS installer? The repaired system will be closed first.
confirm.reboot_anyway: The system could not be closed cleanly. Restart anyway?
fs.btrfs_errors: Btrfs reported errors. Repairing Btrfs automatically is risky, so the wizard will not do it; it continues with the other checks.
problem.mount_failed: The partition for {0} from /etc/fstab could not be mounted.
problem.root_full: The system partition is almost full: {0} GB left. Updates and boot images fail without space.
problem.boot_full: The /boot partition is almost full: {0} MB left.
problem.pacman_lock: The package manager is locked — an update was interrupted.
problem.no_kernel: No kernel is installed in the system.
problem.kernel_mismatch: The kernel {0} in /boot differs from the installed one (damaged or from an unfinished update).
problem.initramfs_missing: The boot image for {0} is missing or empty.
problem.initramfs_broken: The boot image for {0} is damaged — this leads to Emergency Mode.
problem.files_missing: Packages with missing files: {0} ({1}). An update was probably interrupted.
problem.foreign_broken: Packages not from the repositories have missing files: {0}. Reinstall them yourself after booting.
problem.grub_cfg: The GRUB menu (/boot/grub/grub.cfg) is missing or empty.
problem.grub_efi: The GRUB boot loader is missing from the EFI partition.
problem.no_esp: The EFI partition was not found in /etc/fstab.
error.network: No connection to the download server.
error.feed: The list of releases could not be read.
error.no_release: No Equestria OS image was found on the server.
error.no_space: Not enough free disk space for the image.
error.incomplete: The download is incomplete. Press Download again to continue.
error.checksum: The downloaded file is damaged (checksum mismatch) and was deleted. Try again.
error.iso_missing: The image file was not found.
error.iso_unreadable: The file is not a readable ISO image.
error.iso_not_archiso: This ISO is not an Equestria OS live image.
error.iso_no_kernel: There is no kernel in this ISO.
error.no_grub: The GRUB boot loader was not found — the boot menu entry cannot be added.
error.grub_probe: GRUB could not locate the image on the disk.
error.encrypted: The image is on an encrypted partition, which GRUB cannot read before boot.
error.one_shot_fs: GRUB cannot save a one-time choice on this file system.
error.grubenv: Could not write the GRUB environment file.
error.not_mounted: The system is not opened yet.
error.mount_root: The system partition could not be mounted.
error.umount: The system could not be unmounted — close programs that use its files.
error.fs_busy: The partition is in use and cannot be checked now.
error.fs_unsupported: This file system cannot be checked here.
location.hint: A partition on another disk is safer: if the system partition gets damaged, the recovery environment still boots and can check it.
location.hint_done: The image is kept outside the system partition: damage to the system does not stop the recovery environment from booting.
status.location_missing: The image is kept in {0}, but that partition is not connected now.
status.location_missing_hint: Connect the partition, or choose another place below and download the image again.
confirm.location_move: Move the image to {0}? This takes a few minutes.
done.location: The image is now kept in {0}.
progress.verifying: Checking that the image is intact…
recover.auto: Open recovery by itself when the system does not boot
recover.auto_hint: A boot that does not finish — for example, one that stops in Emergency Mode — counts as failed. Starting Windows or other systems from the menu does not count.
recover.auto_limit: Failed boots in a row before recovery opens: {0}.
recover.auto_limit_save_point: Failed boots in a row before recovery opens: {0} — Save Point first tries to roll the system back to a restore point.
recover.auto_unsupported: GRUB cannot count boots here (no ext4 or EFI partition it can write to, or the boot menu runs in text mode), so recovery will not open by itself.
start.text_auto: Equestria OS failed to boot several times in a row, so the recovery environment opened. The wizard will find the system, check what keeps it from booting and fix it. Your files are not touched. If it was a one-off glitch, simply restart the computer.
error.location_invalid: This place is not suitable for the image.
error.location_unsafe: The image folder cannot be used: it is not owned by root.
error.no_live_medium: The medium the live system was started from was not found.
